scripts.dev: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m app; else exec python3 -m app; fi
scripts.start: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m app --no-reload; else exec python3 -m app --no-reload; fi
scripts.db:reset: if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then exec .venv/bin/python -m app.db.reset; else exec python3 -m app.db.reset; fi
